teaser: A worn library card, carried more for other people's holds than your own, rides along in your coat pocket. You are a life path 9, and an INFJ, and the particular weight of this crossing is how much attention goes toward people who are not quite in the room — the ones being imagined into their better selves, the ones the whole world seems to need saving. The pull outward comes from both directions at once, before either leans toward home. What is unusual here is how easily the outward pull looks like calling, until the evening arrives and no one has asked how you are.
